name: Orbit
ownerSetup: rer setup claims the single workspace owner locally with a private one-use setup token; deploy claims the hosted owner the same way. The owner then confirms the workspace at /setup. Native emailed sign-in requires configured mail when hosted.
providerSetup: SendGrid verified sender, unsubscribe group, signed event webhook and signed Inbound Parse/MX configuration
operationalGaps: Service adoption and hosted installation remain separate qualification steps
Native credentials and sessions are excluded from domain archives and must be reconfigured after restore
